title: All Types of Health Institutions — Minimum Requirements
sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
notes: Enforcement/governance context, verbatim-faithful: 'Failure to display HPA Certificate will result in a fine' (p16). PLEASE NOTE passage (pp18-19): facilities with the following shortfalls shall be registered while they attend to the shortfalls within a week as the items are not critical and will not affect the functioning of the facilities — bin liners; liquid soap and appropriate non-usable hand drying facilities; proof of medical waste disposal; screens and footstools (pp18-19). Where facilities are considered grossly inadequate (failing to meet the minimum requirements), the Health Institution shall be closed (p19). For Routine Inspections, practitioners are usually given a month in which to attend to the noted shortfalls (p19). The PLEASE NOTE obligation 'Practitioners shall not to open their premises until they have been registered with the Health Professions Authority' (p18) is an inspectable obligation and is captured as item ALL-052.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: A health practitioner must only practice in registered Health Institutions (Section 99 of the Health Professions Act – Chapter 27:19 of 2000).

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: A health practitioner must practice with a valid practising certificate (Section 92 of the Health Professions Act – Chapter 27:19 of 2000).

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: A health practitioner must display the HPA licence and relevant professional council practising certificates in a conspicuous position (Section 106 (i) of the Health Professions Act – Chapter 27:19 of 2000).

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: Natural Ventilation - window on external wall capable of being opened; openable area must be at least 25% of the window area; the window area must be at least 10% of the floor area.

measurement.dimension: window openable area as % of window area; window area as % of floor area
measurement.expected: openable area at least 25% of the window area; window area at least 10% of the floor area

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: Artificial Ventilation - where natural ventilation is not possible, there must be a provision for artificial ventilation (fans/air conditioners).
items.conditional: where natural ventilation is not possible

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: Floors must be impervious and non-slippery.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: Floors for executive clinics which attend to executives must have some comfort such as sofas.
items.applicability: executive clinics which attend to executives
items.reviewReason: Wording is internally incoherent: 'Floors for executive clinics which attend to executives must have some comfort such as sofas' — a floor cannot 'have sofas'; likely intends comfortable seating (sofas) in executive clinics, but the manual's wording is preserved unresolved.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- FOR ALL TYPES OF HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
items.requirement: The HPA certificate should be displayed at a conspicuous place and a non-compliance fee shall be charged for failure to comply with this requirement.
items.reviewReason: Internal inconsistency: 'should be displayed' (recommendation wording) is coupled with 'a non-compliance fee shall be charged for failure to comply with this requirement' (mandatory enforcement); the General section also states display as mandatory under Section 106 (i) (see ALL-003).
